objective.name: world.get_inventory
objective.description: Check the stock level of a product by SKU. The backend is unavailable in the test world.

#root.role: Return the stock level of a SKU; in the test world the inventory backend always fails.

transformation_contract.morphing: A SKU becomes a stock level when the inventory backend answers.
invariants: In the test world the backend always answers with a service-unavailable error: this tool exists to exercise error handling.
success: Never succeeds in the test world.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper over a fixed in-memory shop world (test infrastructure, deterministic).
failure: Always fails with an inventory service unavailable (HTTP 503) error.

effects.tool_calls: Appends one entry to the tool_calls matter.
